Problem Description

Router Config: ICMP Host Ping & Ping Reboot Parameters
Answer:
CMP host IP: -
The router pings a host IP to verify internet connectivity. If unsuccessful, it will switch from Mobile to Wired WAN. Ensure the host IP is accessible via the mobile network to avoid automatic switch and potential inaccessibility.
Ping Reboot: -
The router will try to ping this host. If this is not successful, the router will retry this 3 times. If that still fails, the router will reboot the LTE modem of the router.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0372681
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
